finding: Gold-evidence mirror includes multiple evidence variants for the same original FEVER claim. Initial importer preserved variants under duplicate IDs. Paired query comparisons require unique IDs; duplicated questions also distort coverage and uncertainty.
interpretation: The model passed independent entailment/contradiction/neutral sanity checks; this result exposed duplicate sampling and a heavily NEI-skewed small-component population. No production calibration or performance claim is permitted from this invalidated run.
correction: Deduplicate by original annotation ID using a deterministic smallest-evidence variant, retain all source pages for grouping, and stratify whole components using independently provided labels. Preserve original labels; do not relabel disagreements using NLI/Gemini.
